project.title: Masque Character Creator
project.summary: PF2e Remaster session-zero and character creator for The Masque of Shattered Mirrors—one player, one GM, spoiler-safe handoff.

items.title: Choose a GM entry point outside the player interface
items.notes: The GM entry must be absent from the player interface. Decide how it should be revealed before restoring the workspace.

items.title: Make default start level configurable by the GM
items.notes: Confirm expected start level with the player before locking defaults (open decision).

items.title: Flag builds that lean hard into combat-as-default
items.notes: Not forbidden—flagged. Soft guidance over pure damage.

items.title: Auto-generate spoiler-gated GM tailoring brief with copy-to-clipboard
items.notes: Stake→scapegoat wiring; art→Verathe framing; faith→deity lever; mask→Marius beat; key skills→NPC/room payoffs. Exit: leave session zero with a personalization plan.

items.title: Add level-appropriate skill increase planner mapped to campaign fit
items.notes: Remaster proficiency ranks. Optional language/lore notes; Osiriani Descent flavor stays GM-side only. Require a complete attribute ledger when assigning skills. Skipped concept answers do not block the planner.

items.title: Ship single export package and import for prior exports
items.notes: Session-zero + attributes + skills + GM brief in one package.

items.title: Polish tone and CSS for a masquerade-adjacent readable UI
Fill README Run locally with real commands and ports
items.notes: Replace TBD port/deploy once implementation exists.

items.notes: Ready to hand a link to the player when desired.
